title: OHO pin progression
author: AQT
desc:
Intermediate rack focused program to get in some serious stimulus for OHP. It's not normal to not be able to press be for reps.
Obviously these are just the singles you're gonna do,so you're free to do everything else you'd normally do. This is bare bones minimum stimulus you need to grow a big press. Run it for a year and be patient with the overload (1% a week is already incredible progress if you can keep it up)
